name: Tropical Fruit & Quinoa Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups quinoa
1062 ml (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large mixing bowl.

Wash mangoes, kiwifruits, bell peppers, and jalapeños. Peel the mangoes, slice flesh away from pit, and medium dice. Peel and medium dice the kiwifruits. Seed and medium dice bell peppers. Seed and mince jalapeños. Peel and small dice onion. Add ingredients to bowl with pineapple.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 mangoes
3 kiwifruit
3 red bell peppers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a small mixing bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lime juice, oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 limes
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp honey
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Uncover quinoa, fluff with a fork, and add to bowl.
Pour dressing over top salad and toss.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and top with green onions. Enjoy!
